# DS Bot view contract

`formula.js` is unmodified from [DeepSeek-Bot v0.2.1](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot/tree/v0.2.1/ds-bot/src/shared), Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE). `views.js` is adapted from DeepSeek-Bot with DS-Bot v0.4.1 declarative view/chart node compatibility extensions. Copyright 2026 Fei2411 and contributors.

The shared app renderer uses the same bounded declarative schema and expression interpreter as the Host. No eval, model JavaScript or HTML is executed. HTML nodes display their summary with a Host-only notice. `views.d.ts` is our typed boundary.
